meta.title: Increase Event Time: Increase Event Time using 30‑minute preset updates end time

plan.title: Increase RFQ Event Time by 30 Minutes

steps.note: Open the prepared live RFQ event required for this test.
Open the RFQ stage page where the submission-time setting is available.
Navigate to the Responses tab specified by the scenario.
Open Increase Event Time, select the 30-minute preset, confirm it, and verify the end time increased by exactly 30 minutes.
Verify the required success toast appeared after saving the extension.
